answer: Sterilize in purpose-designed containers, individually secured. Only endoscopes marked “autoclave” can be autoclaved: clean thoroughly, then sterilize at 134°C for 5–8 minutes. For others, do not exceed 60°C; use chemical sterilization solutions according to the manufacturer’s instructions. Use for illumination and visualization in diagnostic and operative endoscopic procedures
